title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a real-photo example for Session 1 (a grid on a sheet of paper)
body:
## Problem
Session 1 draws the sheet from two angles with a formula; students have no real photos to compare.

## Context
The worked-example experiment asks students to photograph a grid from two angles.

## Expected outcome
Two small photos (under 200 KB each, your own work) and a short note in the Session 1 README comparing the measured width ratio with cos(yaw).

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Photos are your own and small
- [ ] The note states the angle and the measured ratio

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: lens distortion
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet; a homography cannot describe lens distortion.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Real cameras bend straight lines near the picture border.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a clock-offset step to the Session 3 pipeline
body:
## Problem
Session 3 assumes both clocks start together; Session 2 shows how to estimate an offset but the pipeline does not use it.

## Context
Real cameras start a few milliseconds apart.

## Expected outcome
A function that estimates the offset from the displacement series and shifts camera B's times before merging, with a checkpoint on a known offset of 13.7 ms.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Offset recovered to within 1 ms in the pipeline
- [ ] Merged error with a 13.7 ms offset stays below 0.05 px

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: two cameras flowing into one grid
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows two mismatched pictures flowing into one grid while the error map shrinks; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Animation of the warp from raw pictures to one grid
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
